item.title: What is the difference between phone speaker volume and quality?
item.description: Phone speaker volume and quality are independent characteristics that dramatically affect your experience. Volume measures maximum loudness in decibels, while quality determines clarity, balance, and how pleasant audio sounds. A phone can be incredibly loud yet sound terrible with distortion and harshness, or quieter but deliver crisp, balanced audio.
